exitCodes.2: usage, or refused by a guard (edit by hand)
exitCodes.3: needs human approval (a card is waiting)
exitCodes.5: offline, busy, or try again later

context.description: First command of every session: host, generation, deployed commit, working copy, plugins, last switch, runtime summary, enrollment, key rotation, catalogs, skills.

options.description: Full-text search over the option catalogs: path, type, default, origin, description.

args.name: --origin
args.help: only options from this origin (nixpkgs, loom, omanix, home-manager, input:<name>, host:<file>)

where.description: Where an option or a home file is defined: a live eval of the working copy (file:line, priority, value per definition; editable or not). For an HM-owned file: the owning option, the overlay and what shadows it.

args.name: target
args.help: an option path (omanix.theme.default, home.packages) or a home file (~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua)

explain.description: An option's catalog entry, its definitions (where) and its current value.

set.description: Set an option in the working copy: rewrite its one literal host definition in place, or add it under the marker of configuration.nix (home.nix for home.* paths); evaluates the result and reverts on a mismatch. Refuses (exit 2, file:line each) when several host files or an expression define it.

unset.description: Remove the one literal host definition of an option from the working copy, so the default applies again.

check.description: Evaluate (assertions, warnings), check the generated key files against keys.nix, and build the working copy's system. Run before every proposal.

plan.description: check, then what would change: nvd diff against the running system and the git diff stat against the deployed commit.

propose.description: Propose the committed working copy: pushes gate/<topic> and asks for the switch with `loom propose`; the human approves on a card. Waits for the decision unless --no-wait (exit 3: card waiting).

args.name: --request
args.help: the human's words, verbatim (shown on the card)

args.name: --no-wait
args.help: return once the card is up (exit 3)

args.name: --out
args.help: an already built toplevel of that commit (skips the build; loom propose --out)

update.description: Move omanix (or a named input) to its newest release tag (or newest rev), commit, and propose ("Update ready").

status.description: Failed units, persistence gaps, sops decryptability and runtime overlays that shadow declared settings.

doctor.description: Human session: HM links not from the current generation, non-empty overlays and the declared keys they shadow, rebase conflicts, ~/.local/state/hypr shadow files, reclaimed files, overlays left unsettled.

why-failed.description: Why the last thing failed: the last switch's rollback check and journal excerpt, or the most recent failed unit with its log.

try.description: Preview a look-and-feel value live, without a commit (typed allowlist: catalog/preview.json). The human allows it in the chat panel. --reset reverts.

reset.description: Human session: empty runtime overlays (backup in the reclaim dir): an area (look, hypr, shell, theme, font, monitors, input), an overlay path, or --all.

edit.description: Human session: open the overlay for an HM-owned file in the editor; for an HM file without one, show it read-only and name the option that controls it.

args.name: path
args.help: a home file or overlay path (hypr/monitors.lua, ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf)

args.name: --print
args.help: print what would open; don't start an editor

intent.description: Human session: pre-fill the chat composer with a menu intent (ids in $OMARCHY_PATH/default/omanix/intents.json).

inspect.description: Vet a plugin flake without evaluating its modules: outputs, declared inputs, latest tag, whether its owner is already in this host's lock.

add.description: Add a plugin: a flake input (follows for nixpkgs/home-manager/omanix when declared; prefers a tag), its lock node only, and the import in modules/plugins.nix (or home.nix with --home). Sets no option values.

args.name: --branch
args.help: allow a branch ref (shown on the card)

remove.description: Remove a plugin: its import lines, its input and its lock node. Leftover option values become eval errors with file:line.

add.description: Add an app: an omarchy app (omanix.apps.<n>.enable), a web app (--url), a TUI (--command), else a nixpkgs package in home.nix (checked with meta.mainProgram).

remove.description: Remove an app added with app add (or turn an omarchy app off).

set.description: Encrypt a secret value into secrets/<file>.yaml (encrypt-only; never echoed or decrypted). The value comes from stdin: the chat panel's secure field, or the human's terminal.

add.description: Persist a path across reboots: appends it to loom.persist.system.directories (or files) in modules/persist.nix.

audit.description: Files written on the tmpfs root that no persistence entry covers (they vanish at reboot), with the owning unit where known.

probe.description: Which hardware quirks match this machine; --write enables them in the working copy's hardware.nix.

open.description: Human: open the working copy ~/omanix-host (cloned from the local mirror on demand) in the editor, at a file or option.

args.name: file
args.help: a file, or an option path (opens where it is defined)

args.name: --print
args.help: print the path; don't start an editor

path.description: The working copy's path (created from the local mirror on demand with --ensure).
